host.lane: CPU GEMV bench + live serving servers
notes: Host facts recorded in the raw tables: physicalCores=24, logicalProcessors=32, quotaThreads=8, avx2=True.
All three GEMV processes reported: sub4bit axis forcedGrid=auto forcedPrefetch=auto resolvedGrid=gather prefetchHints=on.

Live-decode reruns used temporary configs outside the repo with max_context_tokens 4096, kv_blocks 256, engine threads 0, model placement.thread_quota 8; one server at a time on ports 59101, 59102, then 59103; startup logs confirmed compute_grant requested=8 granted=8.
A first pass that omitted thread_quota is excluded from the reported live numbers because it did not match the documented serving posture.
